statusLine.command: input=$(cat); echo "$input" | jq -r '"\u001b[36m\(.model.display_name)\u001b[0m | ctx: \((.context_window.total_input_tokens // 0) / 1000 | floor)k / \((.context_window.context_window_size // 0) / 1000 | floor)k (\(.context_window.used_percentage // 0)%) | out: \(.context_window.total_output_tokens // 0) tok"'
